STATUS: HAND ADJUDICATION WITH RECEIPTS — the eyes-on pass lexicon v2's stopping rule declared in advance. Every verdict quotes the encoding it was made from.
scope: the MATCHED portion of the lexicon-typed queue, because matched is not verified

vocabulary.SUBSET-VERIFIED: certificate is a subset of a fixed ground set; enters a subset roster
vocabulary.VARIANT-REGION: a subset encoding exists but loses what the canonical object carries; declares a variant at birth or waits for its canonical path
vocabulary.WRONG-REGION: not a subset region under any encoding; leaves the queue

lexicon_false_positive_rate.what_it_measures: the rate at which an L4-subset MATCH is not a verified subset region. This is the honesty accounting lexicon v2's coverage number wanted: coverage says how much the lexicon read, this says how often what it read was right.
lexicon_false_positive_rate.denominator_caveat: 23 matched rows, not a sample of anything wider. It is the rate on THIS queue and is not projected onto the 59 still unmatched.

rows.canonical_encoding: simple undirected graph, adjacency-list; find a minimum vertex set S whose removal leaves every connected component with at most 2|V|/3 vertices; objective = minimize |S|

rows.why: the certificate is a SEQUENCE of single-token moves transforming I_s into I_t. The answer is the transformation, and its order is the content — no subset of a fixed ground set encodes it. Belongs to the reconfiguration/sequence shape, which the census has no class for yet.
rows.canonical_encoding: a graph G and two independent sets I_s, I_t of equal size (token placements); decision: can I_s be transformed into I_t by single-token moves (slide to an adjacent vertex, or jump to any vertex) with every intermediate set independent?
